response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.ID, g.avg_ana, g.avg_ana - m.overall AS excess FROM g, m WHERE g.avg_ana > m.overall ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: GROUP BY ID puts all records with a NULL ID into one group, which appears with a NULL ID in the output.
Groups whose ANA values are all missing have a NULL average. They are left out of the overall mean and cannot be above it, so they do not appear in the result.
The overall mean is the unweighted mean of the group averages, not the mean over all records.
